text: A shopkeeper in Seoul went viral... for telling people not to buy his stuff!
He sells scarves at Namdaemun Market. Six for ten thousand won, about seven dollars.
His sales pitch? "You guys are overspending! You won't even wear them at home!"
Clips of him reportedly pulled millions of views... and then the crowds came.
On October thirty-first, he shut his stall.
He reopened on November fourth... and police were called to manage the crowd.
His words: "I want to make money too, but this isn't right."
He closed again the next day for a safety check. Now he's reportedly hired three private security guards!
Namdaemun is one of Seoul's oldest markets, and some neighbouring sellers say the crowds block their doors.
My take? The best salesman in Seoul is the one begging you to save your money.
